versions.changelog:
- Added a new section inviting users to share their projects and contact the team via email.
- No functional or aesthetic changes to the skill content or configuration.
- Documentation now includes contact information for feedback or showcasing user projects.
Added Live Demo link — try the skill at inspiredhub.ai/demo before installing

- Removed auxiliary files (README.md, skill.json) to streamline the skill package.
- Condensed and clarified SKILL.md, focusing on core Romanticism aesthetic tokens and anti-tokens.
- New, concise color palette included with mood descriptors for direct use.
- Refined application rules for writing, UI design, and branding, emphasizing emotional impact and individual expression.
- Evaluation criteria now clearly specified with must-includes, must-avoids, and confidence threshold.
- Signature works list updated for focus and brevity.
Initial release: 10 style tokens, 5 anti-tokens, 3 signature works, application rules — distilled from 1,491 visual works and 228 literary texts
